The story takes place in the first 20 years of the Showa era, during the last few months of the war that engulfed the world. In a secret Imperial Army research facility, experiments were being conducted to revive soldiers who had been injured and left unable to live as normal human beings. However, these experiments were also aimed at using these soldiers until they completely expired. The only success of these experiments was a young girl named Rei, who had a terminal illness and was being housed at a sanatorium in Izu.
